core_categories: Medical & Surgical Supplies; Surgical Solutions; Front Line Care; Laboratory & Diagnostics; Durable Medical Equipment
specialty_focus: Medline Industries is a manufacturer and broadline distributor of medical and surgical supplies, serving hospitals, nursing homes, home health agencies, surgery centers, and other healthcare settings. It offers over 300,000 products, including proprietary Medline Brand items and products from third-party manufacturers, with a focus on supply chain solutions. While it distributes durable medical equipment, it does not specifically specialize in wearable medical devices.
